comparison.objective: Load washable blender jug and lid into a dishwasher while excluding the motor base; candidate separates ceramic media from metal washers through a screen.
comparison.physical_skill: Selective rigid-object pick-and-place into a rack versus pouring, bimanual screen control, orientation-dependent passage and bridge clearing.
comparison.success_condition: Jug/lid supported and released in rack for 1 s, with any motor entry vetoed; candidate requires all mixture loaded, ≥98% media recovered, every washer retained, no loss/contamination, and released support dwell for 3 s.
comparison.reason: Selection and dishwasher placement do not test granular screening or aperture-mediated separation.
